description: N5/C3 exact-diff review (migration: approvals, exception queue, C2 registry extension)

immutability.instructions: In this migration, the protected columns of an approval and the semantics of an exception case are immutable once written, for both the table owner and the application role

criteria.true: Column-level grants restrict the application role to the lifecycle columns, and a BEFORE UPDATE trigger refuses any change to the action type, parameter digest, keys, risk class, authority, requester, scope, expiry, kind, severity, owner work item or SLA
criteria.false: An approval can be repointed at another action or parameter set, or a case's semantics can be rewritten

transition_guards.instructions: In this migration, illegal state transitions and terminal-state moves are impossible for the application role and for the table owner

criteria.true: An enumerated legality function plus triggers on both request updates and event inserts refuse any edge outside the state machine, including a move away from a terminal state
criteria.false: A status can move outside the enumerated edges, or a terminal state can change

evidence_and_unknown_rules.instructions: In this migration, a decision or definitive execution outcome without evidence is impossible when evidence is required, and an unknown outcome cannot be closed as settled

criteria.true: The decision trigger checks the parent's evidence requirement, the execution CHECK requires a receipt or evidence for a definitive outcome, and the case CHECKs refuse closure without required evidence or closure of an unknown resolution
criteria.false: An unevidenced decision, an unevidenced definitive outcome or a closed unknown resolution can be persisted

human_only_and_closed_registries.instructions: In this migration, a decision can only be human, and every registry (action, risk, authority, status, kind, severity, resolution, activity source/category/action/subject) is closed by constraint

criteria.true: approver_kind is constrained to human, and each registry column and payload vocabulary is guarded by a CHECK so an unknown value cannot be stored
criteria.false: An agent decision or an unregistered action, kind, severity, status or payload value can be persisted

registry_extension_safety.instructions: The change that extends the derived-activity registry is forward-only and preserves every value that was already permitted, without rewriting existing rows

criteria.true: The extension re-declares the affected constraints by name with all previous values plus the new ones, drops nothing else, and rewrites no row
criteria.false: The extension removes a previously permitted value, rewrites or backfills stored rows, or silently re-creates the table

residual_risk.instructions: How much residual risk remains in this database contract, given that it is a bounded synthetic slice

weakest_area.instructions: Which single area of this migration is the weakest and most likely to be defeated by a realistic input

criteria.immutability: Column immutability for approvals and cases
criteria.registries: The closed registries and human-only decisions
